n_65023297a0c2505b.source: export default function({name}){if(!name||name==="YOUR_PLAYLIST_NAME")throw Error("Set the playlist name");return {name,startedAt:Date.now()};}

n_c10c328e09f367c5.name: Prepare next additions
n_c10c328e09f367c5.source: export default function next({items,id,previousState}){const index=previousState===null?0:previousState.index+1;if(index>=items.length)return {state:{index},more:false,id,uris:['-'],removeItems:[{uri:'-'}],count:items.length};const uri=items[index]?.uri;if(typeof uri!=='string'||!uri)throw Error('Invalid track URI');return {state:{index},more:true,id,uris:[uri],removeItems:[{uri}],count:items.length};}

n_23ea697f07afd663.name: Prepare additions report
n_23ea697f07afd663.source: export default function message({name,count,startedAt,kind}){const minutes=((Date.now()-startedAt)/60000).toFixed(1),verb=kind==='add'?'Added':'Deleted';return {message:`### Sync of Liked Songs to ${name} finished.\n#### ${verb} ${count} Songs in ${minutes} Minutes ${kind==='add'?'to':'from'} ${name}.`};}

n_d66c849f0424346c.name: Prepare next deletions
n_d66c849f0424346c.source: export default function next({items,id,previousState}){const index=previousState===null?0:previousState.index+1;if(index>=items.length)return {state:{index},more:false,id,uris:['-'],removeItems:[{uri:'-'}],count:items.length};const uri=items[index]?.uri;if(typeof uri!=='string'||!uri)throw Error('Invalid track URI');return {state:{index},more:true,id,uris:[uri],removeItems:[{uri}],count:items.length};}
